title: Nimble Seafood Spanish Octopus Paella
description: A savory, crunchy, comforting Spanish Valencian dish featuring crusty bread, sous-vide, and paleo-friendly ingredients, inspired by Pulpo a la Gallega and cooked on a Robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide water bath to 130°F (54.4°C).
Season the octopus with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Sous-vide the octopus for 2 hours, or until tender.
Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, water, and octopus to the paella pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the olives, Manchego cheese, and lemon juice.
Transfer the paella to a serving platter and garnish with lemon wedges and crusty bread.
Serve immediately, garnished with parsley and lemon wedges.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
